import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = {
    "date": ["2024-01-01"]*5,
    "time": ["00:00","02:00","04:00","06:00","08:00"],
    "product": ["Cappuccino","Cappuccino","Tea","Latte","Americano"],
    "size": ["Large","Medium","Small","Large","Medium"],
    "price": [4.18,4.01,5.22,6.37,7.07],
    "quantity": [2,3,1,2,3],
    "payment_method": ["Credit Card"]*5,
    "customer_age_group": ["55+","35-44","18-24","45-54","45-54"],
    "is_takeaway": [1]*5,
    "total": [8.36,12.03,5.22,12.74,21.21]
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Convert date and time to datetime
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
df['time'] = pd.to_datetime(df['time']).dt.time

# Pivot the data to get total sales for each product
pivot_df = df.pivot_table(values='total',index='product',columns='size',aggfunc='sum')

# Create a heatmap
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.heatmap(pivot_df, annot=True, cmap="YlGnBu")
plt.title('Total Sales for Each Product by Size')
plt.xlabel('Size')
plt.ylabel('Product')
plt.savefig('output.png')
